title: Northstar fictional beverage artwork checklist
scope: Company review checklist invented for this exercise. Not a regulatory standard. Applies only to SKU FD-OAT-1042 and supplied fictional sources.
normalization_policy: Ignore capitalization and whitespace for exact copy; preserve substantive wording, ingredient order and numbers. Convert mL and L for quantity. Do not silently repair OCR guesses.
absence_policy: Only return a definite missing-content issue when all supplied artwork panels are readable and extraction coverage is complete. Otherwise use unable_to_verify or needs_human_review.

rules.title: Brand and product identity
rules.rule_text: The front panel must display Fieldday and Oat Drink.

rules.title: Variant
rules.rule_text: The front panel must display the approved variant Original.

rules.title: Net quantity
rules.rule_text: Every displayed net quantity must equal the approved specification value. Convert L and mL before comparing.

rules.title: Ingredients
rules.rule_text: The ingredient declaration must match the approved specification, including order and percentages.

rules.title: Allergen wording
rules.rule_text: The artwork must carry the supplied allergen wording from the approved specification.

rules.title: Energy and basis
rules.rule_text: The nutrition panel must show the approved kJ and kcal energy values on the approved per-100-mL basis.

rules.title: Fat and basis
rules.rule_text: The fat value and its per-100-mL basis must match the approved nutrition specification.

rules.title: Protein and basis
rules.rule_text: The protein value and its per-100-mL basis must match the approved nutrition specification.

rules.title: Manufacturer and contact
rules.rule_text: The artwork must include the approved manufacturer name and customer-care email.

rules.title: Recycling qualifier
rules.rule_text: Retain the full supplied recycling phrase, including where facilities exist.

rules.title: After-opening storage
rules.rule_text: Include the approved after-opening storage statement on the retail package.

rules.title: Claim approval evidence
rules.rule_text: Each promotional claim must have applicable approval evidence in the supplied claims register. An absent entry or insufficient evidence requires human review and does not establish that the claim is false or illegal.
